description: Phase C3.9: every file under `src/modules/integrations/orchestrator/` (and the legacy facade `src/services/integration-orchestrator.service.js`) must contain ZERO hard-coded `provider === '<key>'` control-flow branches. The scan target is auto-discovered by `scripts/check-orchestrator-provider-branches.mjs` — adding a new orchestrator-context module is enough to put it under the gate. Provider-specific work runs through the post-ingest hook registry (`src/modules/integrations/orchestrator/canonical-ingestion-hooks.js`); each provider self-registers via the bootstrap entry point at `canonical-ingestion-hooks.bootstrap.js`. Adding a new branch in any scanned file requires writing a hook in the provider module instead and is rejected by the gate.

discovery.note: The `scannedFiles` array below is informational — the script computes its scan list at runtime.

rules.newBranchesNotAllowed: Adding a new `if (provider === '<key>')` branch in any scanned file requires (a) writing a post-ingest hook in the adapter module and registering it via `canonicalIngestionHooks.registerAfterEntities` / `registerAfterLive`, and (b) explicit justification in the PR description. Drive-by additions fail the governance gate. The baseline is empty as of C3.7 because the orchestrator no longer needs to know about any provider key.
rules.autoDiscovery: Adding a new file under `src/modules/integrations/orchestrator/` automatically puts it under this gate (Phase C3.9).
